violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Observed food employee handling lettuce with bare hands. Ready to eat food items should be handled using utensils or gloved hands.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wet wiping cloth found on counter near warmer. Wiping cloths should be stored in a sanitizing solution between uses or laundered.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Thermometer was not available in Pepsi cooler during inspection. Thermometers should be provided in all refrigerated units for monitoring temperature. **Corrected during inspection.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Surface of equipment/utensil did not reach minimum temperature of 160F during hot water sanitize rinse of warewash machine. Inspection thermometer was run through 5 full cycles of the dish machine and reached a maximum temperature of 160F. Dish machines using temperature for sanitizing should be able to heat equipment to 160F.--Water in dish machine was found dirty and had not been used today. Machine should be thoroughly cleaned.
